description: The DuckDB releases Spice is tested with. duckdb: and ducklake: datasets, and the tests that use DuckDB as an oracle, load the DuckDB library installed on the host; the datasets need 1.5.2 or later (MINIMUM_DUCKDB_VERSION in crates/data_components/src/adbc_helpers.rs) and the oracle 1.5.0 or later. The first entry is that minimum and every other entry is the newest patch release of a supported line, so CI tests both ends of each line Spice accepts. Keep the list in ascending order: the last entry is the release the tests, CI and spicescript's duckdb and ducklake sources use by default (--duckdb-version picks another), and CI runs the DuckDB scripts again on every other entry (.github/workflows/e2e_test_ci.yml). Each entry records the SHA-256 of its shared-library archive per platform, which scripts/libduckdb.py checks before installing it; the Dockerfiles carry the same checksums for the newest entry.
